summary: Verified TeamNest.ai AI Employee Builder Phase 3 (Sandbox/Permissions/Tools/Escalation/Deployment) + Phase 4 (Marketplace publish/browse/detail/install/creator dashboard/installs/unpublish + cascade) end-to-end on web. Backend: 34/34 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration95_phase3_phase4.py. Permission-options returns 5 levels + 7 tools; PUT permissions validates level (400 on invalid), GET returns {permission,tools,escalation_rules}. Tools: duplicate → 400, delete 404-guarded. Escalation: add + delete 404-guarded. Sandbox: hits real Claude Fable 5 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (~5s), matching-rule 'refund request' produced escalated=true. Test-runs: rate good/bad + save_as_example creates a Sandbox example; invalid rating → 400; clear removes all. Deployment: handle normalization (mixed-case '!' → 'test_support_bot'), employee.status flips to 'Deployed'; second employee reusing an active handle → 409; chat channel without chat_id → 400; undeploy flips status back to 'Ready'. Marketplace: 12 categories; publish invalid category → 400; publish sets listing status=Published + employee.marketplace_status='Published to Marketplace'; re-publish updates same listing id (no duplicate); browse returns listings with installed+is_mine flags; detail returns preview with all required keys; creator /mine returns summary {total_listings,published,total_installs,total_revenue_usd}; unpublish removes from browse; install clones the whole snapshot (profile+style+permissions+tools+escalation and, when share_knowledge=true, documents+examples), creates a license, increments install_count, and blocks double-install (400); GET /installs lists the license; employee delete cascades marketplace listing (404 on detail). Web UI: authenticated via /api/auth/demo-login, opened an employee, verified all 7 tabs (Profile/Training/Examples/Style/Sandbox/Permissions/Deploy). Permissions tab saved level+risk, added a tool via ep-tool-select+ep-tool-add, added an escalation rule via ep-esc-{trigger,action,add}. Sandbox tab: message sent via ep-sandbox-input+ep-sandbox-send, real Claude Fable 5 reply appeared in ep-sandbox-thread within ~5s, ep-run-good-{id} thumbs-up worked. Deploy tab: filled ep-deploy-handle, ep-deploy-btn deployed, ep-deploy-active card rendered. Marketplace publish card on Deploy tab: title+category filled, ep-market-publish-btn published successfully. /ai-builder/marketplace page renders Browse/My listings/Installed tabs, mkt-search, mkt-cat-{All} chips, and My listings shows the freshly-published TEST_UI_Bot_Listing with correct stat cards. All TEST_ employees created during testing were cleaned up (verified via GET /employees — 0 TEST_ remaining).

minor.issue: Response key is 'ai_response' (persisted-run shape), not 'reply' as the review spec described. Frontend already uses 'ai_response' so no functional break — but the spec + docs and any external API consumers expecting {reply,model,escalated} will be surprised. Consider either renaming to 'reply' or documenting the persisted-run response shape explicitly.

issues: Global 'Credit specials' upsell modal keeps re-opening over the employee profile even after 'Maybe later' was clicked (already flagged in iterations 93 and 94). It intercepts pointer events on Sandbox/Permissions/Deploy tabs and required force=True + repeated dismissals for automation to proceed. Persisting the dismiss (localStorage / server-side) for the session would materially improve the flow.
The 'Have you met AI CMO?' bottom-right cross-sell card also re-renders after tab switches and covers the lower area on smaller viewports (same as iteration 94).

action_items: OPTIONAL: rename POST /ai-builder/employees/{eid}/sandbox response key from 'ai_response' to 'reply' (or add both) to match the documented API contract; today frontend consumes 'ai_response' so it's non-blocking but the spec + external consumers may expect 'reply'.

CARRY-OVER from iterations 93/94: persist a session-scoped dismiss for the Credit-specials upsell modal + AI CMO cross-sell so they don't repeatedly steal focus over power-user flows (AI Employee Builder, Style Training, Sandbox, Marketplace).

OPTIONAL code review: several sandbox+marketplace routes do delete-then-insert (deploy, style-source, save-style, republish) — none atomic. Not blocking but could leave partial state on a crash. Consider find_one_and_update / upserts.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai_employee_builder.py sandbox_reply: the persisted run stores the LLM answer as 'ai_response' but the review request spec (and any external API doc) says the sandbox endpoint returns 'reply'. Frontend uses 'ai_response'. Pick one and align docs + tests. Reference: /app/backend/routes/ai_employee_builder.py:601-608

routes/ai_employee_builder.py deploy_employee: uses delete_many({employee_id}) + insert for idempotency without a transaction — a crash between the two writes leaves the employee 'un-deployed'. Consider find_one_and_replace with upsert. Reference: /app/backend/routes/ai_employee_builder.py:688-695

routes/ai_employee_marketplace.py install_listing: does 6+ separate inserts (employee, style, permissions, per-tool, per-escalation, per-doc, per-example, license) with no rollback — a partial failure leaves an orphan employee shell with a license row but missing pieces. Consider a Mongo transaction (client.start_session with with_transaction) since this is a multi-document write. Reference: /app/backend/routes/ai_employee_marketplace.py:249-291

routes/ai_employee_marketplace.py my_listings: for each listing it does a separate query over ai_employee_marketplace_licenses to sum price_paid (N+1). Aggregate with an $group stage or precompute revenue on install. Reference: /app/backend/routes/ai_employee_marketplace.py:137-140

services/ai_employee_runtime.py generate_reply: uses secrets.randbelow(1_000_000) + 1 as session_id so every sandbox call starts a NEW LLM session — that means the sandbox has NO multi-turn memory even though the UI renders a chat thread. Consider using a stable session id per employee-per-user so follow-up messages have context. Reference: /app/backend/services/ai_employee_runtime.py:114-115

services/ai_employee_runtime.py generate_reply: `except Exception: continue` swallows the underlying LLM error silently for both primary + fallback, so operators cannot distinguish 'model unavailable' from 'auth failed'. Log the exception. Reference: /app/backend/services/ai_employee_runtime.py:124

routes/ai_employee_builder.py _completeness: still fires 8 count_documents queries per employee in list_employees() (flagged iter 93). At >50 employees this becomes 8*N round-trips. Aggregate. Reference: /app/backend/routes/ai_employee_builder.py:35-58 + 154-163

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phases 3+4 backend + web UI are stable. Sandbox uses real Claude Fable 5 (~5-15s per call) via emergentintegrations; the returned run object exposes 'ai_response' (not 'reply' as the spec suggested). Deployment.handle is normalized to lowercase alnum+underscore+hyphen; uniqueness is enforced only across ACTIVE deployments in the same workspace. Marketplace listings are unique per employee_id (republish updates the existing row). Install clones profile+style+permissions+tools+escalation_rules always; docs+examples only when share_knowledge=true. Employee delete cascades ALL phase-2/3 collections + marketplace listings + licenses. UI has two global upsell surfaces (Credit specials modal, AI CMO card) that keep re-appearing over the employee-profile/marketplace pages — dismiss with 'Maybe later' and use force=True clicks. Handy testIDs: ep-tab-{profile,training,examples,style,sandbox,permissions,deploy}, ep-sandbox-{input,send,thread,clear}, ep-run-{good,bad}-{id}, ep-perm-{level,risk,save}, ep-tool-{select,add,{id},del-{id}}, ep-esc-{trigger,action,add}, ep-deploy-{channel-handle,channel-chat,handle,chat,btn,active}, ep-undeploy, ep-market-{title,cat,tagline,price,share-knowledge,publish-btn,unpublish-btn}, and mkt-tab-{browse,mine,installed}, mkt-search, mkt-cat-{Category}, mkt-listing-{id}, mkt-install-btn, mkt-modal-close, aeb-marketplace-btn.
